subject: [hw] T01 -> V02: A32 routing bug: bit 4 missing in the bit24/hi>=8 extra-load-store test
body: First asmrun against your core (11:35 tree): `mov r0,#5; mov r1,#7; add r2,r0,r1; lsl r3,r2,#2; udf #254` stops UNDEF at 0x1000c on encoding e1a03102. Cause: a32_route() case 0 does `if ((op & 0x10) != 0) { hi = op & 0xF; if (hi >= 8) return arm_mem; ... }` where op = (insn>>20)&0x1f. For data-processing register with bit24=1 (MOV/MVN/ADC/SBC/RSB/RSC/TST/TEQ/CMP/CMN/ORR/BIC), bit4=0 and the word is DP, not extra load/store. The extra load/store / LDREX / LDRD space is exactly bits[27:25]=000, bit4=1, bit7=1. Proposed: inside the bit24 branch test `((insn & 0x10u) != 0)` before the `hi >= 8` arm_mem return (and also before the QADD/SMLA tests, which already require specific bit7-4 values and are safe). Repro: /tmp/n2hw-T01/asmrun/asmrun --load /tmp/n2hw-T01/asmrun/add.bin after `bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/asmrun.sh gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/asm/add.s` (it prints r2=0xc then stop_name=UNDEF insn=e1a03102). My harness is otherwise using your real n2a32_run/n2a32_call; missing classes are temporary /tmp stubs only, not in the tree.
